description: Release names returned by Prowlarr-fronted Torznab/Usenet indexers to one Listenarr instance, with the library book each grab was attributed to and what happened. imported = file imported under that book (manual and automatic grabs mixed); import-blocked = import rejected, mostly because the release was a different book (not individually adjudicated; at least one, The Fires of December, was the right book blocked for another reason); download-failed = the grab never completed, identity not adjudicated. Authors came only from the release name (IdentityEvidenceOrigin.ReleaseNameDerived). headAt032e9df5 = BookIdentityMatcher status:reason on PR #591 head 032e9df5; gateAt4b447b11 = the earlier AutomaticSearchRelevanceGate verdict. HTML entities unescaped; no identifiers, paths, clients or timestamps.
